newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Asean listing threatened with suspension.
newsitem.headline: Asean listing threatened with suspension.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange said on Thursday that Asean Investment Corp Ltd's listing was under threat of suspension and possible termination because it had failed to submit its annual financial statements on time.

The JSE said that should the above company not submit these statements by the end of July its listing would be suspended, pending the convening of a Special Meeting of the General Committee of the JSE to consider the continued suspension or termination of its listing.
